definitions.gloss: the way there; outbound route; the route going to a destination
definitions.explanation: The route or journey taken when going to a destination, as opposed to the return trip.

examples.japanese: {行|い}き{道|みち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}った→寄る：02440_yoru⟧。
examples.english: I stopped at a convenience store on the way there.

examples.japanese: {行|い}き{道|みち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{帰|かえ}り{道|みち}→帰り道：12447_kaerimichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧にした。
examples.english: I took the train on the way there and the bus on the way back.

examples.japanese: {行|い}き{道|みち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}かけた→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧⟦{花屋|はなや}→花屋：03136_hanaya⟧で、⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}おう→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I saw a flower shop on the way there and decided to buy flowers on the way back.

notes:
USAGE:
The counterpart is ⟦{帰|かえ}り{道|みち}→帰り道：12447_kaerimichi⟧ (the way back / return route). A common everyday word used when describing what happened during a journey to somewhere.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {行|い}き{道|みち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (on the way there)
- {行|い}き{道|みち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (during the trip there)
- {行|い}き{道|みち}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{帰|かえ}り{道|みち}→帰り道：12447_kaerimichi⟧ (the way there and back)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{帰|かえ}り{道|みち}→帰り道：12447_kaerimichi⟧: the way back — the return route
- ⟦{往路|おうろ}→往路：18214_ouro⟧: outbound route — more formal, used for flights and transportation
